run_moses_tokenizer_cli: run a CLI tool that tokenizes stdin text using sacremoses MosesTokenizer with configurable language
run_tokenizer_with_language: run the tokenizer on stdin text specifying a target language like Spanish or French
run_tokenizer_preserve_tabs: run the tokenizer on tab-separated input preserving tab delimiters between tokenized fields
review_main_function: review the main function that creates a MosesTokenizer and tokenizes each line from stdin
review_tok_inner_function: review the inner tok function that wraps MosesTokenizer tokenize with return_str=True
